children: Fidelity Global Macro Director Jurrien Timmer said Bitcoin has held the bottom of its power-law curve and has corrected for long enough to satisfy the time component of the four-year cycle. According to ChainCatcher, Timmer made the remarks in a post, framing the move as a duration-based adjustment rather than a fresh breakdown.

title: Jurrien Timmer Says Bitcoin Has Held Its Power-Law Curve Bottom
